May 16 Peter Daly - 50 - Dalton, Mass - gastric - ulcers . .. .
Albert ... bad company three yrs. and away from sacrament ... O.K. now Mrs. Mildred B - 29 - Diptheria - 3 child.
D. Shea - 25 - has wife and little baby - 12 days with pneumonia - now complications.

May 31 Randall LaFayette - 17 - swolen neck glands ....
Mark Kramer - 18 - convulsions . .. . weekly since 7 yr. old.
Br. Paul ... 32 - right-hand paralyzed
Mrs. Josephine Blivens - 73 - of Redford - dying May 13. . . Husband 79 to make First Communion next day (May 14) which he did. Wife recovered health and sight - had been blind.
Pearl Hessler - husband & 3 children - losing mind quite John Aspenleiter ... Possessed ...?...?...?
Margaret Troy - 50 - Port Huron - double pneumonia - Enrolled Novem- ber & prayed - a whole week living by oxygen ... astonished all. . is well.
Baby Richard Jos. Bishop - 112 mos. old - has spinal trouble .... Mrs. Anna Kaminski - 62 - Br. Paul's mother
Eliz. Ant. Fuhrman - 55 - terrible cancer both breasts - mother 75 not well.
Tho's Irwin - 24 - broken apendix
Caroline Schulte Taylor - 60 - left orphan at 18 with eleven younger brothers & sisters struggles on like a little mother till all were settled in life; then she married and was blest with 2 children .. . Hus- band not Cat. finally got sick .... invalid ... "Christian scientist visited her and seemed to help her - seven yrs. leaned to "C. Scien- tist .... 2nd youngest Sister urges her to her Confession - begs for sign .... Sees Monstrance in cloud.
